title: Required Clean correspondence stage

source.anchor: ### Requirement: UIREQ-026 Required Clean correspondence stage

requirement: WHEN Sherlock's reference execution design is prepared for compiler/native integration, the design SHALL include the required Lean/Clean semantic, representation and bounded-step correspondence stage.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Recursive semantics and bounded step circuit
scenarios.when: The K reference fragment and Quint bounded abstraction are handed to the compiler/native design work.
scenarios.then: The package includes recursive inductive Lean semantic-value definitions as a required task, a fuel-based step/run relation, a separate fixed-capacity Clean encoding/step-circuit task, source-pinned public reuse inventory, a privately retained Fenrir integration pin/evidence record and named unproved correspondence/backend gaps. The existing pure Lean reference source and its eight normal plus exact-remaining-zero publication checks are historical narrow evidence; they do not implement B bounded images, Clean transition circuits, correspondence or exporters. The public package includes no private paths/code; no Midnight exporter is claimed.

expected.excluded: private paths/code; any Midnight exporter claim

scenarios.blocker: needs the Lean/Clean correspondence package (recursive Lean semantic-value definitions, fuel-based step/run relation, fixed-capacity Clean encoding task, public reuse inventory, gap list)

scenarios.name: Iterate reference models and handwritten circuits
scenarios.when: A Sherlock transition slice or circuit optimization changes.
scenarios.then: Its comparison package follows the [correctness loop](../../../../../docs/SHERLOCK-CORRECTNESS-LOOP.md), identifies K/Quint projections, Lean/Clean and handwritten component membership, independent complete-state/prefix expectations, first divergences and each missing/unrun layer. Observed model agreement does not supply constraint, theorem or native evidence; the workflow grants no execution authority.

expected.comparison package: per docs/SHERLOCK-CORRECTNESS-LOOP.md identifies projections, component membership, independent expectations, first divergences, missing layers
expected.model agreement: not constraint, theorem or native evidence

scenarios.blocker: needs the correctness-loop comparison package generator (K/Quint projections, Lean/Clean membership, first divergences, missing layers)
